summary: Reloads four named resources (globals dword_8AD388/8AD38C/8AD390/8AD394) from a path constructed by joining an override or default base directory with a suffix, then a per-resource name plus a common extension. Each successfully loaded resource is configured with the normalized screen dimensions from this[57] and this[58] at offsets 92 and 96. The first existing resource is released before the reload and the probed path object is removed from the linked list afterwards. Returns the last resource-load result, or 1 when no load runs. Called by RaceInitWithConstants (004d8220).

operations.description: If the first resource global dword_8AD388 is already non-null, release the previously loaded resource by calling sub_4D8FB0 before reloading.
Select the base directory for path construction: use dword_5EC408 when set, otherwise fall back to the default application directory byte_5EA438.
Build the directory path into local buffer v7 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using format aSS "%s%s" from the chosen base directory and the suffix global off_5D4A5C.
Probe/resolve the constructed path by calling sub_53CBC0 with a byref result flag v5; the subsequent load block runs only when v5 becomes non-zero.
Guard on the path-probe result v5; when it is zero the four resource loads are skipped and the function returns 1.

Four sequential resource loads. Each iteration formats a per-resource name as "%s%s" from one of the name suffix globals (off_5D4A48, off_5D4A4C, off_5D4A50, off_5D4A54) plus the common suffix off_5D4A58, then calls sub_53CFE0 with allocation size 133120 to load into the corresponding resource global.

After each sub_53CFE0 load, if the target resource global (dword_8AD388, dword_8AD38C, dword_8AD390, or dword_8AD394) is non-null, configure it: call MaskedFieldSetter(0, 192), then write this[57] (normalized screen width, field this+0xE4) to resource offset 92 and this[58] (normalized screen height, field this+0xE8) to resource offset 96.
Remove the probed path object from the linked list via PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval after the four loads complete.
Return v2, which holds the return value of the last sub_53CFE0 load (dword_8AD394) or 1 when no load path executed.
